model_annotation: The image displays Figure 2(a), which is a bar chart illustrating the inference time in seconds for different Llama-1B models as a function of the batch size. The x-axis represents the batch size, with values of 1, 16, 32, 64, 128, 256, and 300. The y-axis represents the inference time in seconds, scaled from 0 to 10. The chart compares three models: Llama-1B (blue), Llama-1B (orange), and MambaInLlama-1B (red). For all models, the inference time increases as the batch size increases. At a batch size of 1, the inference times are approximately 0.6 seconds for Llama-1B (blue), 0.1 seconds for Llama-1B (orange), and 0.1 seconds for MambaInLlama-1B (red). At a batch size of 300, the inference times are approximately 3.7 seconds for Llama-1B (blue), 3.7 seconds for Llama-1B (orange), and 3.7 seconds for MambaInLlama-1B (red). The chart also includes text labels above each bar indicating the speedup factor relative to the baseline Llama-1B model at a batch size of 1. For example, at a batch size of 300, the speedup for Llama-1B (orange) is 6.2x, and for MambaInLlama-1B (red) it is 6.2x. The legend identifies the three models represented by the different colored bars.
